readout_mitigation.implementation: qem.mitigate_parity; adjoint block solve without dense global matrix
readout_mitigation.model: calibrated assignment blocks, independent between blocks
readout_mitigation.uncertainty: empirical shot variance of corrected parity weights; calibration uncertainty excluded

transform_order: qem calibrated block parity readout correction

notes: For testing DD insertion only. This file does not introduce noise, decoherence, readout errors or hardware timing constraints.
dt is 1 ns. Durations are assumed, independent of physical qubit and rotation angle; null means all qubit locations.
Physical single-qubit gates: 40 ns; SX/SXdg: 20 ns; two-qubit gates: 300 ns; multi-qubit gates: 600 ns.
RZ/P/U1/phase are assigned zero duration, consistent with the experiment's virtual-gate policy.

Opaque unitary/diagonal/multiplexer/Pauli instructions have an arbitrary 500 ns duration irrespective of width. A duration does not guarantee DD scheduler compatibility: offline testing of a longer circuit hit an Unknown operation type for unitary scheduling error.
Measurement/reset/initialization: 1000 ns. These values are placeholders, not realistic performance predictions.
dd_durations.source: Synthetic, user-requested scheduling model for noiseless Aer; NOT IBM calibration data

folding.layout_preserved: native circuit wires and layout retained by qem
folding.method: qem native Qiskit random local unitary folding
folding.native_inverse_policy: Gate.inverse; SX^3 if target lacks SXdg; otherwise reject unsupported inverses
folding.physical_gate_selection: seeded equal-weight physical-gate selection; virtual gates excluded
folding.scale_policy: requested scales used for fitting; recorded gate-count scales are quantized noise proxies, not calibrated noise

measurement_reconstruction.alternating_basis: site n uses X for even n and Y for odd n
measurement_reconstruction.assumption: the density operator is block diagonal in excitation number and supported on the vacuum-plus-one-excitation subspace

method: Experiment 8 native-qem ZNE with Pauli twirling, scheduled dynamical decoupling, and calibrated block readout mitigation
